config.moduleName: Kwama Eggs and Egg Sacs Replacer

plugin.name: Plain
plugin.description: The new meshes and higher-resolution textures only: no bump maps, egg sacs still.

plugin.name: Plain, pulsing egg sacs
plugin.description: No bump maps; the egg sacs pulse so they look alive (02-Pulsing Animation).

plugin.name: Plain, for Graphic Herbalism
plugin.description: Install this if you use Graphic Herbalism. No bump maps, egg sacs still, plus the emptied egg sac mesh Graphic Herbalism shows once harvested (04-Graphic herbalism).

plugin.name: Plain, pulsing egg sacs, for Graphic Herbalism
plugin.description: Install this if you use Graphic Herbalism. No bump maps; pulsing egg sacs (02-Pulsing Animation), then the Graphic Herbalism egg sac mesh (04-Graphic herbalism).

plugin.name: Bump-mapped
plugin.description: Bump maps on the eggs and the egg sacs (01-bump-maps); egg sacs still. Bump maps need a bump-mapping setup (MGE XE shaders); with plain vanilla rendering choose a Plain option.

plugin.name: Bump-mapped, pulsing egg sacs
plugin.description: Bump-mapped eggs (01-bump-maps), then the pulsing bump-mapped egg sac over 01's sac (03-Pulsing Animation Bump-mapped).

plugin.name: Bump-mapped, for Graphic Herbalism
plugin.description: Install this if you use Graphic Herbalism. Bump-mapped eggs and egg sacs (01-bump-maps), plus the bump-mapped Graphic Herbalism egg sac mesh (05-Graphic herbalism bump-mapped).

plugin.name: Bump-mapped, pulsing egg sacs, for Graphic Herbalism
plugin.description: Install this if you use Graphic Herbalism. Bump-mapped eggs (01-bump-maps), the pulsing bump-mapped egg sac over 01's sac (03-Pulsing Animation Bump-mapped), then the bump-mapped Graphic Herbalism egg sac mesh (05-Graphic herbalism bump-mapped).
